name: German as a Foreign Language A1.1: Dive into the grammar and apply it in practice
description:
In this course, basic knowledge of German as a foreign language is taught, enabling students to understand basic rules of word formation and sentence structure and to use them orally and in writing.
Students learn / practise verbs, personal pronouns, nouns, basic prepositions and sentence structure rules that enable them to understand and formulate questions and answers and to give information about themselves and others.
Opportunities are shown to learn basic vocabulary on topics such as family, work, leisure and food, as well as to understand and use numbers, prices and times. Based on the acquired knowledge, communicative skills are applied in typical everyday situations.
